insight: Its Q-Chat tutor launched as one of the first products built on OpenAI's ChatGPT.
name: Quizlet
tagline: Flashcards and study sets with the Q-Chat AI tutor.
description: A study platform best known for flashcards and learning games, now layered with AI through Q-Chat, a conversational tutor that uses the Socratic method to help students reason toward answers. Quizlet Plus removes daily learning-round caps and unlocks AI tutoring plus Expert Solutions for explaining tough problems. The free tier remains usable with reduced limits.

modelSupport.notes: Q-Chat is built on OpenAI's ChatGPT.

edge: Pairs its huge flashcard library with Q-Chat, a Socratic AI tutor that quizzes you toward answers instead of just revealing them.
cons: Daily learning-round caps on free tier
AI tutoring gated to Quizlet Plus
